name: Parties and defined terms
text: ‘THIS ‘CUSTODY AGREEMENT is made by and between Copic Insurance Company, (herein Owner) and Norwest Bank Minnesota, National Association (herein Custodian), on the Ist day of 1999.

name: 1. Services to be Provided by Custodian
text: l. Services to be Provided by Custodian. The Custodian shall: a. 3 b. c. & iA\S206\v 1677.d06 Open and maintain a custody account in the name of the Owner and hold in such account all cash and securities initially deposited plus any additional cash and securities that may be received from time to time for the account. Act upon’ written direction from the Owner or from one or more investment managers duly appointed in writing by the Owner. Settle securities transactions for the account with brokers or others in accordance with the Owner’s or duly appointed investment manager’s written direction. Issue advices to Owner's duly appointed investment managers setting forth particulars of purchases, sales receipts, deliveries, and principal collection. Be responsible for the collection of all investment income relating to the assets in the account. Present for payment all maturing securities or any securities called for redemption and collect proceeds therefrom. Deliver cash or securities in such manner as the Owner may direct in writing. Deliver proxy materials} for securities heid in the account as the Owner may direct in writing.

name: 2. Powers of the Custodian
text: 2. 3 i\5206\v 1677.06 of 7 Powers of the Custodian, The Custodian is authorized and empowered to: a, Hold assets in the nominee selected by the Custodian or such other nominee name as the Owner may direct in writing. b. Employ agents other than persons on its regular payroll and delegate to. them such ministerial and other non-discretionary duties as it sees fit and to rely upon such information furnished by such agents. c. Make, execute, acknowledge, and deliver any and all documents of transfer and conveyance and any other instruments that may be necessary or appropriate to carry out the custodianship duties and powers.

name: 3(a). Monthly statements
text: Reports. Custodian shall furnish to Owner a monthly statement of account reflecting an inventory of assets in the account, all activity during the previous month, and a market value for the assets of the account.

name: 3(b). Other reports
text: The Custodian will furnish such other reports as the Owners may reasonably request, including reports to the Owner's accountants or other examiners as may be necessary.

name: 4(a). Compensation
text: Fees. Custodian shall receive compensation as set forth in Schedule A attached to this Agreement as amended from time to time by the parties,

name: 4(b). Expense reimbursement
text: Custodian shall also be reimbursed by the Owner for its out-of-pocket expenses during the reasonable performance of the Custodian’s duties herein.

name: 5(a). Authorized-person lists
text: Authorized Persons. The Owner and each duly appointed investment manager shall furnish a list to the Custodian (and from time to time whenever there are chenges therein) of persons authorized to act on behalf of the Owner or such investment manager for the purpose of transmitting instructions to the Custodian conceming the assets in the account.

name: 5(b). Reliance on authorized persons
text: The Custodian shall be entitled to rely on the oral advice as confirmed in writing or written advice of such persons.

name: 6(a). Amendment
text: Amendment_and Termination. This Agreement may be amended by written agreement of the parties at any time.

name: 6(b). Termination notice
text: This Agreement shall continue in effect unless or until terminated by either party upon 30 days written notice to the other party.

name: 6(c). Delivery upon termination
text: Upon termination, all securities held in the account shall be delivered by the Custodian to the Owner or in accordance with the Owner’s written instruction.

name: 6(d). Withholding outstanding fees
text: Any fees remaining outstanding and balances owing to the Custodian may be withheld from the assets delivered to the Owner or under the Owner’s direction.

name: 7. Indemnification
text: Indemnification. Owner hereby agrees to indeshnify and hold Custodian harmless — from and against any and all claims, liabilities, and expenses (inchuding attorney’s fees), which Custodian may incur by reason of its acting as Custodian under this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, it is specifically understood and agreed that in the event Custodian has committed negligence or malfeasance in the exercise of its responsibilities hereunder, the indemnification provisions of the Agreement shall not apply.

name: 8(a). Notices to Owner
text: Notices. Notices to the Owner shall be directed and mailed as follows: Copic Insurance Company V. P. Finance 7800 E. Dorado Place, #200 Englewood, CO 80111

name: 8(b). Notices to Custodian
text: Notices to the Custodian shall be directed and mailed as follows: Norwest Bank Minnesota, N.A. Master Trust & Custody Attn: Sue Skonnord MAC N9310-060 Midwest Plaza Tower Suite 700 _ 801 Nicollet Mall Minneapolis, MN 55479

name: 9. Inspection Privileges
text: Inspection Privileges. The books, records, documents, accounting procedures, and practices of the Custodian relevant to this Agreement are subject to examination by the Owner.

name: 10. Governing Law
text: Governing Law, This Agreement and all transactions hereunder shall be governed by, interpreted, construed, and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of Colorado.

name: 11. Effective Date
text: Effective Date. This Agreement shall be effective Aust { i 997

name: 12. Holding of certified securities
text: Certified securities held by the Custodian shall be held either separate from the securities of the Custodian and all of its other customers or in a fungible bulk of securities as part of a Filing of Securities by Issue (FOSBI) arrangement.

name: 13(a). Identification of Owner’s securities
text: Securities held in a fungible bulk by the Custodian and securities in a clearing corporation or in the Federal Reserve book-entry system shall be separately identified on the Custodian’s official records as being owned by the Owner.

name: 13(b). Identification of custody location
text: Said records shall identify which custodied securities are held by the Custodian or by its agent and which securities are in a clearing corporation or in the Federal Reserve book-entry system.

name: 13(c). Additional location and agent identification
text: If the securities are in a clearing corporation or in the Federal Reserve -book-entry system, said records shall also identify where the securities are physically located and if in a clearing corporation, the name and . address of the clearing corporation, and if through an agent, the name of the agent.

name: 14. Registration of custodied securities
text: 14, All custodied securities that are registered shall be registered in the name of the Owner or in the name of a nomince of the Owner or in the name of the Custodian or its nominee or, if in a clearing corporation, in the name of the clearing " corporation or its nominee.

name: 15. Control and withdrawal of custodied securities
text: 15. Custodied securities shall be held subject to the instructions of the Owner and shall be withdrawable upon the demand of the Owner, except the custodied securities used to meet the deposit requirements set forth in Sections 10-3-210, 10-6-116, 10-16-310, 10-16-412, and 10-16-505 of the Colorado Revised Statutes, ‘shall, to the extent required by those sections, be under the control of the Colorado Insurance Commissioner and shall not be withdrawn by the Owner without the approval of the Colorado Insurance Commissioner,

name: 16(a). Transfer confirmations
text: 16. The Custodian shall be required to send or cause-to be sent to the Owner a confirmation of all transfers of custodied securities to or from the account of the Owner.

name: 16(b). Reports of holdings
text: in addition, the Custodian shall be required to furnish the Owner with reports of holdings of custodied securities at such times and containing such information as may be reasonably requested by the Owner.

name: 17. Examination of custody records
text: 17. During the course of the Custcdian’s regular business hours and upon reasonable . notice, any officer or employee of the Owner, any independent accountant selected by the Owner and any representative of an appropriate regulatory body shall be entitled to examine, on the premises of the Custodian, the Custodian’s records relating to custodied ‘securities, but only upon furnishing the Custodian with written instructions to that effect from an appropriate officer of the Owner.

name: 18. Internal-control reports
text: 18. The Custodian and its agents shall send to the Owner (a) all reports which they receive from a clearing corporation or the Federal Reserve book-entry system on their respective systems of internal accounting control and (b) reports prepared by outside auditors on the Custodians or its agents’ internal accounting control of custodied securities that the Owner may reasonably request.

name: 19. Records for statements and audits
text: 19. The Custodian shall maintain records sufficient to determine and verify information relating to custodied securities that may be reported in the Owner's Annual Statement and supporting schedules and information required in any audit of the financial statements of the owner.

name: 20. Affidavits concerning custodied securities
text: 20. The Custodian shall provide, upon written request from an appropriate officer of the Owner, the appropriate affidavits, on a form prescribed by the Colorado Insurance Commissioner, with respect to the custodied securities held, either by " possession or in book entry form, by the Custodian,

name: 21. Custodian indemnification of Owner
text: 21. The Custodian shall indernnify the Owner for any loss of custedied securities occasioned by the negligence or dishonesty of the Custodian’s officers or employees, or burglary, robbery, holdup, theft, or mysterious disappearance, including loss by damage or destruction.

name: 22. Replacement following loss
text: 22, In the event that there is a loss of custodied securities for which the Custodian shall be obligated to indemnify the Owner as provided in Section 21 above, the Custodian shall promptly replace the securities or the value thereof and the value of any loss of rights or privileges resulting from said loss of securities.

name: 23. Force majeure
text: 23, The Custodian will not be liable for any failure to take any action required to be taken under the Agreement in the event and to the extent that the taking of such action is prevented or delayed by war (Whether declared or not and including existing wars), revolution, insurrection, lot, civil commotion, act of God, accident, fire, explosion, stoppage of labor, strikes, or other differences with employees, laws, regulations, orders, or other acts of any government authority or similar causes beyond its reasonable control,

name: 24. Agent liability
text: 24. In the event that the Custodian gains entry in a clearing corporation or in the Federal Reserve book-entry system through an agent, there shall be an agreement between the Custodian and the agent under which the agent shall be subject to the same liability for loss of custodied securities as the Custodian, provided, however, that, if the agent shall be subject to regulation under the laws of a jurisdiction which is different from the jurisdiction the laws of which regulate the Custodian, the Insurance Commissioner of the state of domicile of the insurance company : may accept a standard of liability applicable to the agent that is different from the standard of liability applicable to the Custodian.

name: 25. Insurance representation and warranty
text: 25, \ The Custodian represents and warrants that in connection with its duties and activities as custodian for the custodied securities, it maintains insurance protection consistent with the requirements of the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.
